name: taobao-mnn/MNN-Pocket-0.3B config.json
notes: Fetched 2026-11-10. model_type qwen3, architectures [Qwen3ForCausalLM]. num_hidden_layers 28, hidden_size 896, intermediate_size 2560, num_attention_heads 14, num_key_value_heads 2, head_dim 64, vocab_size 65536, tie_word_embeddings true, max_position_embeddings 40960, rope_theta 1e6, rope_scaling null. layer_types is 28 x 'full_attention' with sliding_window null and use_sliding_window false - so every layer holds a per-token KV cache and none is windowed. use_cache is FALSE in the shipped config, which is an on-device export default, not evidence that the architecture lacks a KV cache; the HF safetensors repo still exposes a standard qwen3 decoder. No expert/top_k/moe key of any kind -> dense. Grepped for expert|top_k|topk|moe before concluding.
